text:
Incident Bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike observed for streaming-api (us-west-2) — p95 420ms (+2.5x), p99 1.9s (+4x). Increased streaming stalls and partial payload timeouts. SLOs breached. Auto-suppression: none. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream.
Jordan (on-call): I'm taking this. TL;DR?
Ben S: Seeing large increase in cache misses on kv-prefix namespace. Hit rate dropped from ~90% to ~35% across multiple shards starting at 3361120120.
Carla R: Any recent deploys or config changes around prefix hashing?
Jordan (on-call): Yes — a staging->prod rollout earlier this morning: commit `e8f3b7a` changed prefix hashing salt and sharding mapping (linked rollout). Rolling update started at 3361119000.
Ben S: Confirmed. Compare of `kv.get_stats()` before/after:
```
before: {hit_rate: 0.91, p99_miss_latency: 8ms}
after:  {hit_rate: 0.35, p99_miss_latency: 120ms}
miss_rate_spike: +260% on prefix cohorts 0x3a..0x4f
```
Carla R: That explains the low reuse and sudden eviction pressure — hotkey churn + cold prefixes -> high tail lat.
Maya - Support: Any customer impact? Any escalations?
Jordan (on-call): We have ~15 customers with elevated error rates on streaming sessions; 3 customers reported session stalls in last 20m. No major FRT errors but user-level streaming stalls. Preparing PSR if needed.
Ben S: Logs show repeated cache misses leading to fallback to paging layer and increase in backend fetch time. Sample log: `WARN kvcache: prefix-miss key=usr:chat:acf123 shard=shard-17 fallback=pagefetch latency=145ms`
Carla R: Mitigation options (fast): 1) rollback the prefix-hash change (reduces miss rate), 2) enable legacy routing for affected cohort (route to older key derivation), 3) bulk rewarm critical prefixes, 4) increase cache TTL / reduce eviction for 10m, 5) temporary throttling of new sessions.
Jordan (on-call): Prioritize rollback + rewarm. Ben, can you prepare the rollback? Carla, start a targeted rewarm plan. Maya, prep customer comms (status page + reach out to top 5).
Ben S: Running deploy check now. If rollback approved, I'll trigger canary rollback to previous deploy `d4c2a11`. Expected cooldown ~3–5min for caches to stabilize.
Carla R: Rewarm approach: generate synthetic traffic for top 200 prefixes (per telemetry) using `scripts/rewarm_prefixes.py --list top200.txt --concurrency 40`. Will warm both kv-cache and streaming local caches. Also will pin those prefixes to avoid eviction for 15m: `kv.set_ttl(prefix, 900)`.
Jordan (on-call): Ben — please run the rollback and post the deploy bot confirmation here.
Deploy Bot: `rollback started -> target commit d4c2a11`
Ben S: Rollback triggered. Watching rollout.
Carla R: Starting rewarm now. Running in batches (0/40 warmed). Will report rate.
Ben S: Rollout at 40% nodes. No new 5xx. Observing hit_rate tick up on shard-17: 35% -> 48%.
Jordan (on-call): Good. Any downstream overload on paging? Watch p95 of backing store.
Carla R: Batch 1 complete: warmed 40/200 prefixes. Early signs: miss_rate for warmed prefixes down to ~6%. Continuing.
Maya - Support: Drafting message: "We're investigating streaming stalls affecting some users in us-west-2; rollout rollback and mitigations in progress. ETA 30 minutes for initial stabilization." Want approval?
Jordan (on-call): Yes send now to status page and ping top customers. Add that we're rolling back a prefix hashing change.
Ben S: Rollout complete. Deploy Bot: `rollback complete -> stable at d4c2a11`
Jordan (on-call): Observed p99 drop: 1.9s -> 580ms within 3m of rollback. p95 back to ~220ms. Still above SLO target but trending.
Carla R: Rewarm 3/5 batches done. Overall shard hit_rate now 72%. Per-cohort hit delta: cohorts 0x3a..0x4f improved from 28% -> 70%.
Ben S: Paging backend latency stable. No sustained error spikes. We'll keep rewarm until top200 prefixes are at >85% hit.
Maya - Support: Notified top 5 customers, posted to status page. Customer replies: two customers acknowledged, one asked for RCA timeline.
Jordan (on-call): Start an RCA draft — include root cause: prefix hash salt change + rollout timing + insufficient canary coverage for cohort distribution.
Carla R: Additional follow-ups: add a preflight sim that measures cohort distribution delta for any prefix-scheme change; add a throttled roll out across shard boundaries; track hit_rate delta per cohort in canary dashboards.
Ben S: I'll open a follow-up PR with rollback-safe rollout (feature flag + gradual remap) and a canary test that replays prefix distribution.
Alice M: I'm taking the on-call handoff at 3361123200. Jordan — any outstanding action for me?
Jordan (on-call): Handoff checklist: 1) ensure rewarm completes (Carla will monitor), 2) verify hit_rate >85% across cohorts in next 30m, 3) coordinate final RC/PR for rollback-safe rollout, 4) keep Support updated. Everything else stable.
Alice M: ack. I'll monitor for 2 hours, will escalate if p99 > 1s again.
Carla R: Final note — we observed one anomaly: a mis-indexed bloom filter on shard-12 that amplified misses for ephemeral prefixes. Filed ticket #INC-8472.
Jordan (on-call): Thanks everyone. Leaving notes in the incident doc and starting PSR.
Maya - Support: Closing initial customer outreach loop; will prepare follow-up emails after RCA. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> partial mitigation applied (rollback + rewarm). Monitoring.
Alice M: closing thread here for handoff — will re-open if we see regression.
